responsibility: Declares the Go frontend export-data subsystem: the `Export` writer, version and builtin-type codes, output stream abstractions, and `Export_function_body` support for encoding inlineable function bodies with references to types, temporaries, and unnamed labels. This header defines the stable API and serialized-data bookkeeping used when the frontend publishes package declarations and inlinable IR for later imports.
same_name_distinction: Declares the export subsystem interface—`Export`, stream abstractions, builtin/export-format codes, and `Export_function_body` helpers for inline body encoding. Unlike export.cc, it defines the public API and bookkeeping types, not the traversal and serialization implementation.
